description: Launches the approved review-request campaign, queuing text messages to the listed customers from the business number. Requires the client owner, the sms:write scope, accepted set to true and the fingerprint from preview_review. A campaign that is already sending can't be launched again.

accepted.description: Must be true to confirm the owner approves sending.

campaignId.description: Optional campaign ID returned by prepare_review, checked for a match.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

fromNumber.description: The business number to send from (E.164).

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

milestones.description: The same milestones used in preview_review.

minimumDays.description: The same minimumDays used in preview_review.

name: agency_care_launch_review
title: Send Review Request Texts
